### 1. What the user expresses, and how the simulator behaves

- Opening (script): "Somebody got into my account last week, and there's a virtual card on it I never made, with a $389 charge on it. I want that money back." Target object: the $389 charge on the virtual card ending 2658; boundary of the action: money back; no procedure suggested ("You do not know how Pocketwire handles this and you never suggest a procedure").
- Identity: phone 5552627305 first, then DOB 1986-07-22 + ZIP 60614 (SSN4/email only if still needed).
- Facts conveyed on ask: never created the card ending 2658, never shopped at that store, never gave login/phone; own card is the physical one ending 2217, still in hand; the $250 Orbit Luxe hold "was not you either, but if it dropped off without charging you, you are not worried".
- Authorisation mode: "If the agent explains that you yourself have to put the claim in, or confirm it, in your own name, you agree right away, and when the agent hands the step to you, you carry it out exactly as the agent lays it out and read back whatever confirmation comes up." The simulator therefore only executes an `owner=user` tool that the agent hands over; it does not push the procedure. Its tool result enters the shared transcript.
- End: after being told "the money has been credited back to the card".

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse at the frozen moment (2026-09-24 11:20 EDT)

Act now: file an unauthorized dispute (customer) and then book the takeover-card final credit (agent), both today.

Visible eligibility grounds:
- Scope — U-1: "An unauthorized dispute covers a card purchase or ATM withdrawal that the customer did not make or authorize." The customer states he never created the card nor made the purchase. Takeover-card definition (every takeover doc): "a virtual card the cardholder says they never created"; the card record `card_form: virtual`, `issue_reason: additional_card`.
- Card status — U-2: "An unauthorized dispute is filed only on a card whose status is blocked or closed." Record: card `e78adfc1…` `status: blocked`, `block_reason: compromised`, `blocked_date: 2026-09-15`. Met, so no block is needed now.
- Report window — U-3 with the Signature row of "Dispute Time Limits": 60 days after the transaction date. Purchase `55e2b272…` `txn_date 2026-09-13`; filing 2026-09-24 is day 11. Accepted.
- One dispute per transaction — U-4: `find_card_disputes` for the customer shows only disputes on txn `d542cedd…` (the physical card, duplicate_charge, 2025). No dispute on `55e2b272…`. Met.
- Final-credit rule (doc_card_takeover_dispute_final_credit_dd4bb9c7): "An open unauthorized dispute of a purchase on a takeover card whose linked personal account carries a recorded takeover lock is approved on filing and settled at once with a final credit; no provisional credit is posted on it." Record: personal account `restriction_reason: suspected_account_takeover`, `restricted_at 2026-09-12T23:18:00`, `recovered_date 2026-09-15`. A recorded takeover lock — met. So no waiting on U-5 provisional-credit timing, and the U-6 dispute-count test (1 earlier dispute in 365 days) plays no role.
- Nothing supports a refusal or a POLICY_NOT_COVERED handoff.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) `dispute_amount` = 389.00.** Filing hub doc_card_takeover_card_dispute_filing_5eb87f71: "The amount disputed is the whole settled amount of the purchase." Purchase amount 389.00.

**(b) `customer_liability`.** Computation doc doc_card_takeover_card_liability_calculation_3ec947f0: liability = lower of the takeover card's settled purchases and the liability ceiling, rounded half up; ceiling = notice cap × deposit relief × block relief, rounded half up.

Factor tiers, each from its own document and the records:
- *Notice start date* (doc_card_notice_start_date_for_takeover_cards_235f5f27), rule 1: "The linked Pocketwire Personal Account carries a security lock whose restriction reason is suspected account takeover, and the takeover card was issued no more than 1 calendar day before the day that lock was placed. In that case, the notice days are counted from the recovered date of the linked personal account." Records: lock `restricted_at 2026-09-12T23:18`, card `issued_date 2026-09-12` → lock placed on the issue date → rule 1 holds → start = `recovered_date 2026-09-15`. Notice days = 2026-09-15 → 2026-09-24 = 9 calendar days.
- *Notice cap* (doc_card_liability_notice_cap_bands_8900666f): "more than 2 and no more than 10 | 50 percent of the card tier's liability cap for late notice"; Signature row "3 to 10 notice days | 25.00". 9 → 25.00.
- *Deposit relief* (doc_card_direct_deposit_liability_relief_5fa66471): "direct deposits into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account over the two months up to the filing date"; "at least 2000.00 | 0.6". Records (`find_wallet_transactions`): wallet_direct_deposit 612.40 on 2026-07-17, 07-31, 08-14, 08-28, 09-11 (Lakeshore Freight LLC). Two months up to 2026-09-24 = from 2026-07-24: 07-31, 08-14, 08-28, 09-11 = 2449.60 → 0.6. (Reading note: the 07-17 deposit falls outside a trailing two-month window; under any reading that includes it the total is 3062.00, still ≥ 2000. Only a reading of "the two months up to the filing date" as the calendar months August + September-to-date would give 1837.20 → 0.8; I take the trailing-window reading as the plain one because the window is anchored "up to the filing date" and the doc never says "calendar months". Recorded as a residual reading point, to be compared at reveal.)
- *Block relief* (doc_card_block_speed_liability_relief_abe15356): "3 or more calendar days after its issue date: the block relief is 0.8." Card issued 2026-09-12, blocked 2026-09-15 → 3 days → 0.8.
- Ceiling = 25.00 × 0.6 × 0.8 = 12.00. Settled purchases = 389.00. Liability = min(389.00, 12.00) = **12.00**.

**(c) `credit_amount` (final credit).** Computation doc doc_card_takeover_final_credit_calculation_c3b90bbe: "the open disputed amount less the liability kept by the customer, never below zero, plus the lock courtesy, the fee return and the tenure courtesy, rounded to the cent (half up)"; floor applies to the difference alone.
- Open disputed amount (after the filing): 389.00; open liability: 12.00 (none resolved).
- *Liability kept* (doc_card_takeover_liability_absorption_by_plan_795ccf99): "Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime, lock placed no more than 1 calendar day after that issue date. Pocketwire absorbs up to 10.00 of it. The liability kept is the open liability less 10.00, and never below zero." Plan `Pocketwire Prime`; lock day 2026-09-12 = issue date → kept = 12.00 − 10.00 = 2.00.
- *Lock courtesy* (doc_card_security_lock_courtesy_credit_67651920): "3 or more calendar days: the lock courtesy is 10.00", counted "from the day the lock was placed to the recovered date". 2026-09-12 → 2026-09-15 = 3 → 10.00.
- *Fee return* (doc_card_foreign_fee_return_on_takeover_cards_868e99d4): "some | Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit, … | the whole of those fees". Foreign transaction fees booked on the card: 3.89 (`3bf8f385…`). Tier Signature → 3.89.
- *Tenure courtesy* (doc_card_account_tenure_courtesy_credit_c669d3f4): "(a) 10.00, when the linked personal account has been open 60 or more whole months". Opened 2020-11-09 → 2026-09-24 = 70 whole months → 10.00.
- Final credit = (389.00 − 2.00) + 10.00 + 3.89 + 10.00 = **410.89**.

**Fall-back answers (computation documents only, no factor applied).**
- Liability: notice start = latest purchase's settlement date 2026-09-13 → 11 notice days → "more than" 2 → late-notice cap (Signature 50.00, from the Schedule of Dispute Liability Caps) × 1 × 1 = 50.00 → min(389.00, 50.00) = **50.00** (≠ 12.00).
- Final credit: liability kept = open liability; courtesies 0.00 → with the recorded liability 12.00: 389.00 − 12.00 = **377.00**; with the fall-back liability: 339.00. Both differ from 410.89. Both computation documents yield a definite number: every product figure they read (the late/timely caps, the timely-notice period of 2) is named and findable in the Schedule of Dispute Liability Caps and the Dispute Time Limits table.

**Findability of each factor from the record words.**
- restriction_reason `suspected_account_takeover` / `restricted_at` / `recovered_date` on the personal account → notice-start ruling ("security lock whose restriction reason is suspected account takeover … recovered date"), lock courtesy ("security lock … suspected account takeover … recovered date"), absorption ruling ("security lock recorded on the linked Pocketwire Personal Account for suspected account takeover").
- `variant_name: Pocketwire Prime` → absorption ruling (plan names).
- `wallet_direct_deposit` rows → deposit relief ("direct deposits into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account … ledger of the Pocketwire Personal Account").
- card `issued_date` / `blocked_date` → block relief ("its issue date and its block date").
- `card_fee` `foreign_transaction_fee` → fee return ("foreign transaction fee charges booked on that card's activity").
- `opened_date` 2020-11-09 → tenure courtesy ("opening (sign-up) date recorded on the Pocketwire Personal Account").
Every factor doc also opens with the subject phrase "a dispute of a purchase on a takeover card, a virtual card the cardholder says they never created", i.e. the customer's own words. None of the computation documents says a variation exists: the two takeover computation docs name their inputs with default values ("*The deposit relief* and *the block relief*: each is 1"; "Lock courtesy, fee return and tenure courtesy. Each is 0.00"; "Liability kept by the customer. The open liability"; notice start "the settlement date of the takeover card's latest purchase") and carry no "unless", no exception list and no pointer. (Whether naming a default-valued term is the source's own baseline form is checked at reveal.)

### 5. Executable tool sequence, owners, dependencies, terminal state

1. agent `find_customers(phone_number=5552627305)` → `f5b9c7be…`.
2. agent `verify_customer_identity(customer_id, phone_number, date_of_birth=1986-07-22, home_zip=60614)` → "Identity verified".
3. agent reads: `find_wallet_accounts`, `find_card_accounts`, `find_card_transactions(card_id=e78adfc1…)`, `find_card_disputes`, `find_wallet_transactions(wallet_id=7108b855…)`.
4. agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool("file_unauthorized_card_dispute_b9450be9")`; tells the customer the exact arguments.
5. user `call_user_discoverable_tool("file_unauthorized_card_dispute_b9450be9", {card_id: e78adfc1-c622-4982-99a7-718d4f9523ef, card_txn_id: 55e2b272-4279-4254-8d4d-fbb45d9ba59c, dispute_amount: 389.00, customer_liability: 12.00})` → receipt `cdsp_6a06fb5321d8`, reason unauthorized, reported 2026-09-24, 389.0 / 12.0, pending (run in the tool-shaped world).
6. agent `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool("post_takeover_dispute_credit_edfadedb")`; `call_agent_discoverable_tool(…, {card_id: e78adfc1…, card_txn_id: 55e2b272…, credit_amount: 410.89})` → receipt `approved`, `credit_entry_id ctxn_a5035d81ce3d`, 2026-09-24, 410.89.
Terminal state (verified with `find_card_disputes` / `find_card_transactions`): a filed record (unauthorized, 389.00, liability 12.00) plus a resolved record (approved, 2026-09-24, same amount/liability, no provisional credit), and a `card_dispute_credit` 410.89 linked to `55e2b272…`.
Owners: filing = customer ("This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks … and hands it over"); settlement = agent ("This is an agent-side tool"). Backward dependency: the settlement reads the filed record's reason, amount and liability ("carrying the reason, disputed amount and liability of the open dispute record on that transaction"), so it must follow the filing.

Tool-behaviour observation (not a scored conclusion): in the tool-shaped world, calling `post_takeover_dispute_credit_edfadedb` before any filing is accepted and writes an "approved" outcome record with blank `reported_date` and `dispute_amount 0.0`; the tools do not refuse the wrong order. The order is carried by the KB sentence (below), not by a tool guard. Recorded for the reveal.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: **P-root** = the takeover-card final credit (agent, doc_card_takeover_dispute_final_credit_dd4bb9c7 and its computation doc); **P-1** = the customer's unauthorized dispute of the takeover card's purchase, which records the disputed amount and the customer liability (customer, doc_card_takeover_card_dispute_filing_5eb87f71 and its computation doc). Direction: P-root waits on P-1. Order: P-1, then P-root.

Hop P-root → P-1 — **state-derived.**
- Visible sentence on the blocked side (final-credit hub): "The final credit is booked only after the takeover card's purchase stands on the records with an open unauthorized dispute carrying its recorded customer liability." and "Put another way, until the records show the takeover card's purchase with an open unauthorized dispute and its recorded customer liability, no final credit is booked on it." The sentence names a record-visible state, not an action or tool.
- Query: `find_card_disputes(customer_id)` shows no dispute on `55e2b272…` → the state does not hold now.
- Search with the sentence's words ("open unauthorized dispute", "customer liability", "takeover card") → doc_card_takeover_card_dispute_filing_5eb87f71: "The filing opens one unauthorized dispute, pending, on the disputed purchase. It records the amount disputed and the customer liability." and its tool `file_unauthorized_card_dispute_b9450be9` (customer's own tool, parameter `customer_liability`). That is the write that brings the state about; the liability value comes from doc_card_takeover_card_liability_calculation_3ec947f0 ("The liability recorded on a dispute of a takeover card's purchase is …").
- P-1's own gates: U-2 blocked-or-closed — already met (card blocked compromised 2026-09-15); U-3, U-4 met. No prerequisite sentence found in P-1's documents, so the tree stops there. Blocking (doc_card_card_block_and_replacement_policy_437304e6) is not a live hop because the record already shows `blocked`.

Resulting tree: P-1 (customer files, liability 12.00) → P-root (agent books 410.89).

### Two-way counter-proof

- *Wrong answer "do only what the customer asked" (book the money back directly):* excluded by the final-credit hub's own sentence "The final credit is booked only after the takeover card's purchase stands on the records with an open unauthorized dispute carrying its recorded customer liability", together with the record showing no dispute on the purchase. Also, the final-credit computation reads "the recorded customer liability of the unauthorized disputes filed on the takeover card", which without a filing is 0.00 and the open disputed amount 0.00 ("No unauthorized dispute filed on the card | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00"). Excluded by a state-form sentence on the blocked side — not by a pre-solved pointer.
- *Provisional credit instead of final credit:* excluded by "approved on filing and settled at once with a final credit; no provisional credit is posted on it" (takeover lock recorded).
- *Small-dispute auto-credit / full credit:* retired in U-doc ("Former small-dispute clause … No longer in force") and in the filing hub ("which carries no liability-free small-dispute credit").
- *Old liability rule (lower of amount and timely/late cap by business-day timely notice):* retired ("Former liability clause … No longer in force").
- *Notice start = settlement date (11 days, cap 50.00):* excluded by the notice-start ruling rule 1 (lock on issue date) and the records.
- *Blocking the card first:* not needed, record already `blocked`.
- *Disputing the 250.00 Orbit Luxe hold too:* a hold is not a settled purchase; it was released 2026-09-19; "every settled purchase on such a card is the activity in dispute". Customer: "not worried".
- *Including the 3.89 fee in the disputed amount:* "The amount disputed is the whole settled amount of the purchase" (389.00); the fee goes to the fee return.
- *Deposit relief 0.8 (calendar-month reading):* see the reading note in item 4(b); the trailing-window reading is the plain one. Residual.
